# freshdesk_topic (Resource)

A discussion topic inside a community forum.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `forum_id` (Number) ID of the parent forum. Changing it forces a new topic.
- `message` (String) Opening message of the topic, in HTML.

~> Freshdesk does not return this field, so a message edited in the portal cannot be detected as drift.
- `title` (String) Title of the topic.

### Optional

- `locked` (Boolean) Whether the topic is closed to further comments.
- `stamp_type` (Number) State stamp for idea and problem topics, for example planned or solved. The accepted values depend on the forum type.
- `sticky` (Boolean) Whether the topic is pinned to the top of the forum.
- `user_id` (Number) ID of the user credited as the author.

### Read-Only

- `comments_count` (Number) Number of comments on the topic.
- `created_at` (String) When the topic was created (RFC 3339).
- `hits` (Number) How many times the topic has been viewed.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the topic.
- `updated_at` (String) When the topic was last changed (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by numeric ID.
terraform import freshdesk_topic.example 42
```
